Night sky and ocean, cosmic and aquatic mix, bioluminescent colors, fast-paced visual chaos, surreal comedy.", "shots": [ {"time":"00:00-00:03","type":"WIDE","action":"The Moon, a glowing crescent with arms, hangs a 'GONE FISHING' sign on the night sky. He grabs a shooting star like a surfboard and leaves.","camera":"Wide cosmic shot.","dialogue":"Moon: 'Finally. Some me time.'"}, {"time":"00:03-00:06","type":"WIDE","action":"A temp worker anglerfish inflates into the sky, wobbling into position. His lure is blindingly bright.","camera":"Low angle from ocean looking up.","dialogue":"Anglerfish: 'Don't worry, boss! I got this!'"}, {"time":"00:06-00:09","type":"MEDIUM","action":"An owl puts on tiny sunglasses, annoyed. Worms pop out of ground thinking it's daytime. A rooster crows confusedly.","camera":"Rapid cuts.","dialogue":"Owl: 'Turn it down, Gary!'"}, {"time":"00:09-00:12","type":"WIDE","action":"Tides go sideways. Fish swim through the air. A lighthouse sees the anglerfish's bright lure and gets jealous.","camera":"Chaotic wide, tilting horizon.","dialogue":"Lighthouse: 'Am I a joke to you?'"}, {"time":"00:12-00:15","type":"CLOSE-UP","action":"The lighthouse starts spinning like a disco ball, casting colored beams across the ocean. Party music starts.","camera":"Close-up of lighthouse face.","dialogue":"Lighthouse: 'If you can't beat 'em, join 'em!'"}, {"time":"00:15-00:18","type":"TRACKING","action":"Moon surfs back on his shooting star, furious, leaving a streak across the sky.","camera":"Following shot, fast.","dialogue":"Moon: 'NOBODY. COVERS. MY. SHIFT.'"}, {"time":"00:18-00:22","type":"WIDE","action":"Moon grabs the anglerfish by the lure and yeets him back into the ocean. The anglerfish splashes, deflated.","camera":"Wide action shot.","dialogue":"Anglerfish: 'Worth it!'"}, {"time":"00:22-00:25","type":"WIDE","action":"Moon fixes the sky. Tides return to normal. Fish fall back into water. Lighthouse stops spinning, embarrassed.","camera":"Sweeping wide.","dialogue":"Moon: 'Amateurs.'"}, {"time":"00:25-00:28","type":"CLOSE-UP","action":"Moon settles back into position, pulls out a tiny fishing rod, and actually fishes from the sky. Catches a cloud.","camera":"Push-in.","dialogue":"Moon: 'Now THIS is a break.'"}, {"time":"00:28-00:30","type":"TITLE CARD","action":"Black screen. Title 'MOON'S NIGHT OFF' in glowing letters with a tiny fishing hook.","camera":"Static.","dialogue":"(soft splash)"} ] }

zh.content: { "title": "月亮的夜班休假", "style": "3D Pixar 家庭动画。夜空与海洋，宇宙与水生元素混搭，生物荧光色彩，快节奏的视觉混乱，超现实喜剧。", "shots": [ {"time":"00:00-00:03","type":"WIDE","action":"月亮——一个发光的弯月，长着手臂——在夜空中挂上一块写着“GONE FISHING”的牌子。他抓起一颗流星当冲浪板，离开了。","camera":"宇宙广角镜头。","dialogue":"Moon: 'Finally. Some me time.'"}, {"time":"00:03-00:06","type":"WIDE","action":"一只临时工琵琶鱼膨胀着升到天空中，摇摇晃晃地就位。它的诱饵亮得刺眼。","camera":"从海面向上看的低角度。","dialogue":"Anglerfish: 'Don't worry, boss! I got this!'"}, {"time":"00:06-00:09","type":"MEDIUM","action":"一只猫头鹰戴上小墨镜，满脸不耐烦。蚯蚓们从地里冒出来，以为天亮了。一只公鸡困惑地打鸣。","camera":"快速切镜。","dialogue":"Owl: 'Turn it down, Gary!'"}, {"time":"00:09-00:12","type":"WIDE","action":"潮汐横着流动。鱼在空中游来游去。一座灯塔看到琵琶鱼明亮的诱饵，顿时嫉妒起来。","camera":"混乱的广角镜头，地平线倾斜。","dialogue":"Lighthouse: 'Am I a joke to you?'"}, {"time":"00:12-00:15","type":"CLOSE-UP","action":"灯塔开始像迪斯科球一样旋转，向海面投射彩色光束。派对音乐响起。","camera":"灯塔脸部特写。","dialogue":"Lighthouse: 'If you can't beat 'em, join 'em!'"}, {"time":"00:15-00:18","type":"TRACKING","action":"月亮骑着他的流星冲浪板冲回来，怒气冲冲，在天空中拖出一道长长的光痕。","camera":"跟拍镜头，快速。","dialogue":"Moon: 'NOBODY. COVERS. MY. SHIFT.'"}, {"time":"00:18-00:22","type":"WIDE","action":"月亮抓住琵琶鱼的诱饵，把它猛地扔回海里。琵琶鱼扑通一声落水，瘪了下去。","camera":"广角动作镜头。","dialogue":"Anglerfish: 'Worth it!'"}, {"time":"00:22-00:25","type":"WIDE","action":"月亮把天空修好。潮汐恢复正常。鱼重新落回水里。灯塔停止旋转，尴尬不已。","camera":"横向扫过的广角镜头。","dialogue":"Moon: 'Amateurs.'"}, {"time":"00:25-00:28","type":"CLOSE-UP","action":"月亮重新回到原位，掏出一根迷你钓竿，真的开始从天空钓鱼。钓上来一朵云。","camera":"推近。","dialogue":"Moon: 'Now THIS is a break.'"}, {"time":"00:28-00:30","type":"TITLE CARD","action":"黑屏。标题“MOON'S NIGHT OFF”以发光字样出现，旁边还有一个小鱼钩。","camera":"静止。","dialogue":"(soft splash)"} ] }
